risk_note: RV2 by path (orders, ledger, payout, agent, growth read-only exports; identity port; app.module). Personal-information copy sources (BR-ID-40 「导出范围（默认）」): identity declares the port and reads the account (full bound phone, login methods, registration time), realname (masked per BR-ID-33) and the user-subject consent records; orders, ledger, payout, agent and growth each export one read-only reader of the member's own section through their index.ts; app.module assembles them. Every section runs on the caller's READ ONLY handle, scoped by app_id and the member, plain SELECTs without locks, no writes and no logs; amounts pass through as stored integer fen; payee accounts are masked; no other user's data; the invite section is only whether an inviter is bound. Agent conversations within the BR-ID-30 ① retention: app.module reads agent.trace.retention_days on the caller's handle and passes the computed days to agent (agent never hands a db handle to another module — [AC-B3-08k#1]). No contract, schema or migration. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36) in three rounds (round 2: ledger fixture sign; round 3: one type annotation, D10-206), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent (one fix for the foreign-handle rule).
